notes.title: Athena's throwing wheel Content Update!
notes.content:
Another day, another Athena game.

added Athena's throwing wheel, a simple "Wheel of death" inspired game using mouse controls.

notes.title: Athena's cannon content update!
notes.content:
About two weeks ago, I made a custom atari 2600 game for newgrounds, but unfortunately I couldn't port it to anything other than web :( 
(You can play that [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/974089]here![/url] )

So, two days ago, I got to work on a FULL remake with new features Specifically for Steam!

(credits to DennisRX for playtesting)

Aside from that, I also fixed a bug with Athena's highwire where the controller wouldn't work past level 2.

Thanks for playing!
